actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.findFormByTitle.description: Finds an existing forms by title.
actions.findFormByTitle.props.title.desc: The (partial or full) title of the form to search for.
actions.getFormResponses.description: Fetch all responses for a Fillout form, with optional filters.
actions.getFormResponses.props.includeEd: Include a link to edit the submission.
actions.getFormResponses.props.limit.des: Max number of submissions to retrieve (1-150).
actions.getFormResponses.props.search.de: Filter for submissions containing this text.
actions.getFormResponses.props.status.de: By default, only finished submissions are returned. Select "In Progress" to get unfinished submissions instead.
actions.getSingleResponse.description: Retrieves a specific submission from a form.
actions.getSingleResponse.props.includeE: Include a link to edit the submission.
actions.getSingleResponse.props.submissi: Select from the 50 most recent submissions for the chosen form.
auth.description:
To get your API key:
1. Go to your Fillout account settings.
2. Click on "Developer settings".
3. Generate and copy your API key.
4. Paste it here.
description: Create interactive forms and automate workflows with Fillout
triggers.new-form-response.description: Triggers when a new submission is received for a selected Fillout form.
